title: Obstruct a free general spectral Riemann-coordinate extension with a rational four-species example
statement: For reduced resistance C_ii=f_i4+sum_{j!=i,4}(f_ij-f_i4)c_j,C_ij=(f_i4-f_ij)c_i, choose(f12,f13,f14,f23,f24,f34)=(1,2,3,4,5,8) at(c1,c2,c3,c4)=(1/4,0,0,3/4). Its simple eigenvalues are(3,4,13/2), and the left covector for3 is omega=(1,p,q)=(1,-1/2,-1/14). The supplied exact perturbation derivatives(q_c2,p_c3,p_c1,q_c1)=(1/7,1/2,-4,-20/49) give the omega wedge d omega coefficient q_c2-p_c3-p*q_c1+q*p_c1=-27/98. A local eigen-coordinate with differential proportional to omega would require this coefficient zero. The simple eigenbranch and nonzero obstruction persist into nearby open-simplex points. This rules out automatic integrable spectral coordinates in general, not other entropy-variable methods or the full controlled-PDE theorem.
